resources.string: A three-week cycle: volume, recovery, realization. 9 sessions. Trace adaptation without microplates; rate difficulty before saving. Choose max attempts manually.
Check your maxes and body weight
Pause for 3 counts at the top and bottom of each rep.
Choose your attempt weight manually. Record a successful result; do not mark a failed attempt as completed.
Controlled form, no failure. Pause at the bottom on dips; start pull-ups from a dead hang.

Percentages include half your body weight: (1RM + body weight / 2) × percentage − body weight / 2. Round down to 1.25 kg. Rate the whole heavy or technique block: reps in reserve +2.5 kg; solid +1.25 kg; at your limit hold. Missing the minimum reps reduces heavy or technique loads by 5%. Volume: at least 6 reps in every set +2.5 kg; 5 +1.25 kg; otherwise hold. Trace adaptation: no 0.5 kg increments, max attempts are manual, preparatory loads follow heavy-load changes. Keep the scheduled rest days.
Enter known added-weight maxes and your body weight. Future sessions update; current sets are preserved.
Check actual reps and rate the entire block. If any set was at your limit, hold the weight.
